plan_a:
Mono-White Death & Taxes: deploy taxing hatebears (Thalia, Mother of Runes, Phyrexian Revoker) and grind on tempo. Lock their mana with Rishadan Port + Wasteland, protect creatures with Mother of Runes, and suit up a threat with Stoneforge Mystic -> Batterskull/Jitte. Swords to Plowshares removes their threats. Attrition and mana-denial win; don't race combo, disrupt it.

plan_b:
Izzet Delver tempo: land a cheap threat early (Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Murktide Regent), then protect it and race while denying their mana. Counter their key spells with Daze, Force of Will, Spell Pierce; burn their blockers and face with Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning; Wasteland their duals. You are the beatdown when ahead on board — count clock vs their outs before trading.
YOUR DECKLIST (you know your own deck's contents; only the draw order is hidden): 4x Brainstorm, 2x Chain Lightning, 4x Daze, 4x Delver of Secrets, 4x Dragon's Rage Channeler, 4x Flooded Strand, 1x Force of Negation, 4x Force of Will, 7x Island, 4x Lightning Bolt, 3x Murktide Regent, 4x Ponder, 1x Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, 4x Scalding Tarn, 2x Spell Pierce, 4x Volcanic Island, 4x Wasteland
